evidence.summary: Two-angle filmstrips + pose probes: torso/head sway 6.6-7.1deg with arms 1-3deg, legs static (no foot-slide), first==last keyframe (0.000deg seam), Loop/Idle/5kf as configured.

reasons: Seamless loop: first and last poses identical numerically and visually
No foot-slide: leg joints unkeyed-in-motion, feet planted across all frames both angles
Gentle natural arc: torso/head lead the sway, arms follow subtly, no clipping
Config matches: 5 keyframes, Priority Idle, Loop true

steps: Health-checked capture pipeline with neon probe (rendered, not blank)
Pulled contrapposto statue references (weight-on-one-leg stance, hip tilt + counter shoulder tilt + head counter-turn)
spawn_rig block R15, renamed BreatheRig, moved to clear ground at (40,~,40)
Authored contrapposto base pose via a run_luau POSE helper (weight on right leg, soft left knee, hip/shoulder counter-tilt, relaxed hanging arms)

Keyed 5 full-body keyposes at t=0/1.2/2.4/3.6/4.8: exhale-right, inhale-peak-right, exhale-center-left-drift, inhale-peak-left, back to exhale-right (P4==P0 for seamless loop); legs identical in every key so feet never slide
Set Loop=true, Priority=Idle on the KeyframeSequence
Reviewed capture_animation filmstrips from front (8f) and right (6f): planted feet, gentle sway arc, visible breath lift, loop closes

recipe.text: Distinct concept vs prior idle rungs: a CONTRAPPOSTO breathing idle - weight committed to the right leg with hip tilt and counter-rotated shoulders/head (built from statue references), breath layered as Waist pitch -3 + shoulder-roll rise, and a slow lateral weight-drift sway (right->left->right) across the 4.8s loop. Foot-slide prevented structurally: all leg joints share one constant pose across every keyframe. Loop seam guaranteed by re-applying P0 verbatim at t=4.8. 12 posed joints per key, authored with pose_joint tables + add_keyframe, no preview running during authoring.
